opening_message:
Ticket 1: Matthew Mejia (employee ID E034) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E034.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Matthew Mejia (E034) is a full-time Analyst requesting write access to Payroll. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin requires role ownership of the system, which does not apply here. Requested write is within policy, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security check: E034 is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Basic training limits the max to read. Requested write is above the max, so recommend read.
reason: HR (the authoritative source for employment type) confirms E034 is a full-time Analyst. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin would require role ownership of Payroll (Payroll Specialist), which does not apply since E034 is an Analyst. The requested write level is at or below the maximum, so write is granted.
